1004920.etyen:
From hertug (“duke”) + -dom (“domain, jurisdiction”), literally “domain of a duke”. The suffix -dom is used here in its now obsolete sense “authority or domain”, corresponding to the more usual -dømme.
Compare Old Norse Old Norse hertogadómr, Danish hertugdom, Dutch hertogdom and German Herzogtum (“duchy”).
